newsitem.title: KENYA: Heavy fighting outside Kisangani, airport threatened.
newsitem.headline: Heavy fighting outside Kisangani, airport threatened.

text.p: Zairean rebels have overrun main government defences on the eastern side of Kisangani in heavy fighting and the international airport there is within firing range, a regional military source said on Saturday.

"The rebels have overrun and captured the main government defence positions on the eastern side of Kisangani. Two main rebel columns have now merged outside the city and the airport is within firing range," the source said.

The source, who closely monitors the war between Laurent Kabila's Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo-Zaire (ADFL) and Zaire's ragged army, said Zairean troops were looting as they fled the country's third largest city.
"The soldiers are looting Kisangani as they flee. Many are leaving by boats. There is confusion among the citizens," the source added.
The source spoke after U.N. relief agencies and foreign embassies in Kinshasa said they were seeking ways to evacuate expatriates from Kisangani after reports of mortar fire outside the city.

The fall of Kisangani, which the rebels claim is imminent though government forces deny this, would be the biggest setback to date for the government of ailing President Mobutu Sese Seko in a five-month rebel campaign.
